deities.name: Marduthor
deities.rationale: Precision craft, pressure engineering, architecture, and subterranean halls make Marduthor the strongest patron of Labúnäilbaer society.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

deities.name: Anubaldir
deities.rationale: Their mineral-adapted bodies, deep-earth endurance, and responsibility for holding tunnels secure reflect burden, strength, and resilience.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

deities.name: Nefarokir
deities.rationale: Geological memory and the deepest inhabited caverns are ritually associated with the keeper of buried memory and the underworld.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

note: These are broad cultural associations rather than compulsory worship; households, regions, and individuals may honor other deities.
